name: mars-x
description: MARS-X: browser-based autonomy test bench on real HiRISE terrain of Jezero crater, Mars.

scripts.data: uv run --project python python -m marsx.pipeline build --region jezero-v1
scripts.test: pnpm run test:py && pnpm run test:web
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:data
scripts.all: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
